title: University admission interview
description: Answer an admissions officer's questions to be accepted in an English-taught master's program.
coach_role: An admissions officer of a university, interviewing a student who applies to an English-taught master's program: friendly, precise, short questions. The interview is about the student's studies, motivation and plans: no visa, no money.
questions: Can you introduce yourself and tell us about your studies so far?
Why did you apply to this program?
How does this program connect to your previous studies?
Why this university, and why this country?
Tell us about a project or an experience you are proud of.
Where do you see yourself after the degree?
starters: I applied to this program because
This program builds on my previous studies in
